UserSave.title: UserSave
UserSave.description: Private cloud save state for an authenticated Pixel Spire climber.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the save owner.

username.description: Player's chosen unique username, or empty if not yet claimed.

freeHeadstarts.description: Stocked free 100m headstart tokens earned from Mon-Fri Online Races.

claimedRaceWeeks.description: List of completed race week IDs whose podium rewards have been claimed (max 32).

unlockedSkins.description: List of unlocked climber skin IDs (max 22).

selectedTheme.description: Currently active dungeon theme ID or dynamic mode.

unlockedThemes.description: List of unlocked dungeon theme IDs (max 9).

secretUnlocked.description: Whether the secret climber skin has been unlocked.

secretRevealMethod.description: Revealed unlock method text once secret skin is earned.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when cloud save was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cloud save sync.

UsernameClaim.title: UsernameClaim
UsernameClaim.description: Unique lowercase username reservation mapping a handle to its owner UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this username.

usernameLower.description: Lowercase normalized username matching document ID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the username was claimed.

RaceEntry.title: RaceEntry
RaceEntry.description: Public weekly Mon-Fri Online Race leaderboard entry for an authenticated climber (zero PII).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the racer.

displayName.description: Public climber handle or display alias (no email/PII).

skinId.description: Equipped climber skin ID during the best race run.

bestAltitudeMeters.description: Highest altitude reached in this weekly race.

bestScore.description: Highest score achieved in this weekly race.

bestTimeSec.description: Elapsed seconds for the best altitude run.

runsCount.description: Number of race attempts logged this week.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the racer entered this week's race.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest race entry update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private cloud save profile belonging strictly to userId.

/usernames/{usernameLower}.description: Unique username reservation documents enforcing case-insensitive uniqueness.

/weeklyRaces/{weekId}/entries/{userId}.description: Public Mon-Fri weekly online race standings keyed by ISO weekId and racer UID.
